thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] abnormal token QPS detected for org=larkspur-org across /generate-recs (p95 token rate > 8x baseline). Auto-throttles kicked in. Paging on-call.

alex: oncall here, looking. saw the spike around 12:41 UTC. Larkspur is hitting continuous long-context requests (avg 4k tokens).

mia: support chiming in — Larkspur's CSM just DM'd they started a batch import from a partner integration, confirm high lat/429s from their side. Customers seeing failures for ~10% of requests.

eric: checking infra. host-level looks fine (GPU util ok) but per-org qps guardrails bumped them to 100 rps -> queue growth. We need either temporary quota bump or route them to low-cost model variant.

alex: can we do a quick emergency org-level quota adjustment? Risk is they keep sending and blow burst budget. Need manual approval from SRE lead.

sasha: Sasha (SRE lead) - approve an emergency, timeboxed increase. Propose: raise livable qps by 3x for 15 minutes, enable request-size cap 2k tokens on generate-recs to slow extremes, and create a fallback to smaller-context model for new sessions. Any objections?

eric: +1. Implementation plan: 1) run admin API to increase org quota; 2) deploy transient routing rule to route larkspur-org to recs-compact-v1 for sessions with >2k tokens; 3) notify CSM.

mia: I'll notify CSM/PD about short window and ask partner to pause imports.

alex: executing admin patch now. Command:

```
# increase org throttle units (internal admin)
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/orgs/larkspur-org/override-quota" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"qps_multiplier":3,"duration_seconds":900,"reason":"emergency spike - partner import"}'
```

incident-bot: admin:quota-override accepted (id=ovr-3827). Effective immediately.

devops-bot: applied routing rule to recs service: route_id=rt-9012, rule: if org==larkspur-org && session_tokens>2000 -> model=recs-compact-v1.

eric: throttle change shows in metrics: org_qps limit now 3x, active queues dropping. Latency on /generate-recs p95 down from 2.1s -> 1.3s in ~45s.

taylor: product — do we need to disable any heavy features? If Larkspur continues, might need to disable multi-doc fusion for their org (feature flag).

sasha: let's hold on disable. If after 15m queue doesn't stabilize, we'll escalate to disabling fusion. For now monitor.

mia: CSM confirmed they paused partner import and will throttle back immediately. They appreciate the quick bump.

alex: keeping on-call watch. Logging commands used for postmortem:

```
curl -s "https://metrics.internal.redwood/orgs/larkspur-org/series?metric=token_qps&window=5m" | jq .
admin-ctl list-overrides --org larkspur-org
```

incident-bot: Reminder: override ovr-3827 scheduled to expire at 2034568800 (900s). If we want to extend, must get approval and record justification.

eric: propose we mark this as an "org surge mitigation" incident and grab a short incident ticket for timeline and RCA.

sasha: agreed — alex, please open a short incident ticket and add initial timeline. Assign to infra+support for RCA.

alex: ticket created: INC-2023-larkspur-qos (link: https://redwood.atlassian/INC-2023-larkspur-qos). I'll add commands, metrics, and the CSM note.

-- 20 minutes later --

eric: override expired; metrics look stable, queue level healthy. No 429s reported from Larkspur.

sasha: great. No further action. Recommend follow-up: 1) identify why partner import created unthrottled long-context requests, 2) add a soft-request-size cap in control plane for orgs starting new bulk imports, 3) review default per-org burst budgets.

taylor: product will schedule a design spike to add server-side import throttler + better SDK guidance.

mia: CSM will send a note to Larkspur summarizing mitigation steps and confirm they resumed work slowly.

alex: thanks team. Closing thread but will dump logs into INC ticket for the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
